draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.21, the 84th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 13th of 35 at WR. He lasted until pick 112, well after his grade rank (84th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Keelan Cole. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (10th percentile). College production: 478 receiving yards in 2020, 25th of 35 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Detroit Lions. 83 career games and 75 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 13 AV in 2025 against a career-best 15 in 2023. Strengths in 2025: team target share 31.3% (100th percentile), receiving td 11 (99th percentile), receiving yards 1,401 (98th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 wide receiver who played: 1,401 receiving yards against a median of 255, above the norm.
